scenes.title: Honey Bunny Can't Sleep
scenes.subtitle: A Bedtime Story  •  Honey Bunny Kidz

lines.text: Honey Bunny Kidz presents: Honey Bunny Can't Sleep!
Once upon a time, in a cozy little home under a big oak tree, lived a fluffy little bunny named Honey.
Honey had soft, sandy fur, long floppy ears, and a pretty pink bow.
It was bedtime. Mama Bunny tucked Honey into her warm, snuggly bed.
Goodnight, my little Honey. Sweet dreams.
Goodnight, Mama!
The little night light glowed soft and yellow. Honey closed her eyes. Then, she opened them again.
Mama, I am not sleepy at all!
She wiggled her nose. She wiggled her ears. She wiggled her tiny toes. But she still was not sleepy.
Mama, how do my friends fall asleep?
Let's take a little peek outside together, and ask them. Then, straight back to bed.
Yay! Thank you, Mama!
Mama Bunny held Honey's paw, and they peeked outside. The stars were twinkling, and the meadow was quiet and calm.
By the little pond, they saw Dotty the Duckling, snuggled in her nest.
Hello, Dotty! How do you fall asleep?
Hello, Honey! I count the twinkly stars. Let's count them together!
Can you count with Dotty? Ready?
One.
Two.
Three.
Four.
Five!
Ooh, counting makes me feel so sleepy. Goodnight, Honey.
Goodnight, Dotty!
Up in the big oak tree sat Ollie the Owl, with big, round, friendly eyes.
Hello, Ollie! How do you fall asleep?
Hoo, hoo! Owls sleep in the daytime, little one. But I know a sleepy secret.
Take a big, slow breath in, like smelling a pretty flower. Then let it out, slowly, like blowing on a dandelion.
Let's try it too. Breathe in.
And breathe out.
One more time. Breathe in.
And breathe out.
Ahh. My body feels soft and calm.
Hoo, hoo. That's the way. Goodnight, Honey.
Thank you, Ollie! Goodnight!
Then Honey looked up at the big, round Moon, smiling down from the sky.
Mister Moon, how do you help everyone sleep?
I shine my soft, gentle light, so the night is never too dark. And I watch over all the little ones while they dream.
Thank you, Mister Moon!
Now, little one, it's time to go back to bed.
Mama Bunny tucked Honey back into her cozy bed, snug as a bug in a rug.
Let's say goodnight to everything.
Goodnight, stars. Goodnight, Dotty. Goodnight, Ollie. Goodnight, Moon.
Goodnight, soft pillow. And goodnight, warm blanket.
Goodnight, Mama. I love you.
I love you too, my little Honey.
Honey took one big, slow breath, and drifted off to sleep.
And now, it's time for you to sleep too, little one. Close your eyes, take a slow breath, and have the sweetest dreams.
